name: Spicy Blackberry Pulled Chicken Sandwich with Butter Lettuce Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place broth, vinegar, Worcestershire, sugar, and spices in a medium saucepan. Stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
118 ml chicken or vegetable broth
apple cider vinegar
2 tsp Worcestershire sauce
2 tsp brown sugar
1 tsp chili powder
½ tsp garlic powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tomato
1 medium carrot
1 (170 g) pkg blackberries
½ head butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid is boiling, add chicken to the pan and reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and cook until chicken is cooked through, 12-15 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, place mayo, vinegar, oil, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp mayonnaise
apple cider vinegar
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp basil, dried
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tomato. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the bowl and set aside.
When the chicken is done, transfer to a plate, leaving the liquid in the pan.
Add blackberries and hot sauce to the pan, then mash with a potato masher to create a chunky sauce. Return to medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Return to the pan with the reduced sauce, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide buns between plates. Top the bottoms with pulled chicken, then close with the top half of the bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
